source.name: Zoomph (NFL Practice Jersey Patch Sponsors guide; updated 2026-09-01)
source.quote: A proudly local Louisiana brand, Rouses Markets keeps its roots close to home as the official patch sponsor of the Saints.

note: Practice-jersey patch. Deal start unknown: Zoomph lists Rouses Markets as the Saints' official patch sponsor for the 2026 season, but no announcement of when the deal began was found (2026-10-01).
